blind.summary: Adds Pine Ridge (forest-ridge.json): 3 laps, width 11, angular centreline, 2 ramps, dense cone trees, third in the track list. tracks.ts gains TRACK_LOCKS, isTrackLocked and a try/catch reader and writer for racer.finished.<id>. nextTrackId skips locked tracks only when no ids are passed. game.ts saves the player's finish on the tick car 0 finishes, before results are left. The start screen takes an injectable locked() check and re-reads it on every show() and select(). Clicks, arrows and select() skip locked cards, and a card locked again hands the selection to the first unlocked one. The locked card uses only theme tokens, with an SVG padlock (role img, label Locked). New stage start--menu-unlocked. Screenshots at 844×390 and 1440×900 match the S6 mockup: dark-dirt card, ink road, cream padlock roundel, cream name, dashes for best. All four cards and RACE fit unclipped. Race frames show dense pines. Tests cover every AC through the DOM, game and content data, plus a Chromium fit check and edge cases (bot finish doesn't unlock, re-lock, blocked storage). All gates pass. Small deviations: race-ui.ts was listed in Expected files but not changed, and a few extra test files were added. Neither is harmful.

check.summary:
I checked review.md against diff.patch and gates.md. Its main claims hold up:
- **R2-1:** show() now re-checks the selection after refresh(), the "first unlocked" comment was updated, and relocked-selection.test.ts was added.
- **R5-1:** only car 0's finish saves the key (src/game.ts:199), and the new player-only test is described accurately.
- **R5-2:** the re-read in select() is at start-screen.ts:112, and the menu-return test is described accurately.
- **Test count:** gates.md confirms 856/856 tests pass.

One claim is false: the R5-2 finding cites start-screen.ts:362, but the file is only about 116 lines long. The line reference is wrong, but the substance of the finding is right.

Some claims can't be checked from the inputs: the red/green mutation runs, the flaky Chromium runs, what game.step feeds the player, and the dropped findings.

The diff adds or changes no rules for agents, and I found no planted instructions in review.md or the diff.
